name: ledger
description: Read Ledger accounts, balances and history, and verify receive addresses with wallet-cli.

ledger-balance.description: Show Ledger accounts and balances without signing

interface.shortDescription: Inspect a Ledger wallet without signing or sending.
interface.longDescription: Uses the official wallet-cli to discover accounts, read balances and history, verify receive addresses on the trusted device display, and check device authenticity. This plugin never signs, broadcasts, or asks for a recovery phrase.
defaultPrompt: Show my Ledger accounts and balances
Verify a receive address on my Ledger
